rule: Review remediation must commit push reply before resolve
description: P3. The antecedent list — fix is committed, pushed, validated, and a fix-SHA reply is posted — IS this rule (the rule name is that list). Pinning only `Resolve review threads only after` leaves every precondition rewritable with the suite green. Honest residual: source and consumer are the same file and the same clause, so this fixture protects one sentence in one file; it asserts no cross-file coupling.

source.pattern: Resolve review threads only after fix is committed, pushed, validated, and a fix-SHA reply is posted

consumers.pattern: Resolve review threads only after fix is committed, pushed, validated, and a fix-SHA reply is posted
